"""RoboWits hold_cup episode controller. Run with python /app/output/gen.py [stage]."""
import json, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = Path('/app/output')
RUNS = Path('/app/runs/hold_cup')
RUNS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def observe(r, label, depth=True):
    o = r.get_obs(depth=depth, video='none')
    from PIL import Image
    for cam, im in o.last.items():
        Image.fromarray(im).save(OUT / f'{label}_{cam}.png')
    if depth:
        for cam, dep in o.last_depth.items():
            np.save(OUT / f'{label}_depth_{cam}.npy', dep)
    (OUT / f'{label}_meta.json').write_text(json.dumps(o.meta, indent=2))
    return o

def tcp(o, side):
    n = np.asarray(o.meta['proprio']['now'], dtype=float)
    start = 16 if side == 'right' else 23
    return n[start:start+7].copy()

def pose_path(r, o, side, goals, seconds_per_row=0.5, note=''):
    """Move one TCP through explicit world-frame [x,y,z,qw,qx,qy,qz] waypoints."""
    cur = np.asarray(o.meta['proprio']['now'], dtype=float)
    pr, pl = cur[16:23].copy(), cur[23:30].copy()
    path=[]
    for p in goals:
        path.append(list(p)+[float(cur[7] if side=='right' else cur[15])] +
                    (list(pl)+[float(cur[15])] if side=='right' else list(pr)+[float(cur[7])] ))
    # Interpolate waypoints at no more than 2 cm / 2 degrees per row to keep motions deliberate.
    expanded=[]
    prev=np.r_[pr,cur[7],pl,cur[15]]
    for row in path:
        q=np.asarray(row,float)
        # Translation subdivisions are based on the moving TCP. Orientation is held here.
        ix=0 if side=='right' else 8
        dist=np.linalg.norm(q[ix:ix+3]-prev[ix:ix+3])
        n=max(1,int(np.ceil(dist/0.025)))
        for t in np.linspace(1/n,1,n): expanded.append(prev+(q-prev)*t)
        prev=q
    res=r.submit('ee_pose',np.asarray(expanded),dt=seconds_per_row,video='both',video_fps=5,cameras=['ego',f'wrist_{side}'],note=note)
    res.save(str(RUNS / f'{int(time.time())}_{note or "move"}'))
    print('move',note,'rows',len(expanded),'done',res.meta.get('done'),res.meta.get('reason'),'steps',res.meta.get('control_steps_chunk'))
    return res

def stage_inspect():
    r=Robot(); print('status',r.status())
    o=observe(r,'before_inspection')
    (OUT/'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(r.spec(),indent=2))
    n=np.asarray(o.meta['proprio']['now'],float)
    q=np.r_[n[:7],n[8:15]]
    pR=n[16:23].copy(); pL=n[23:30].copy()
    # Lift the right wrist clear of the table, then move it above the ramp for a close camera view.
    a=[.626,-.290,1.10,*pR[3:7]]
    b=[.53,-.10,1.10,*pR[3:7]]
    for target in [a,b]:
        ik=r.ik({'Gripper_Tip_R':target},seed=q)
        if not ik['ok']: raise RuntimeError(f'IK failed for inspection waypoint: {ik}')
        q=np.asarray(ik['q'],float)
    res=pose_path(r,o,'right',[a,b],seconds_per_row=.5,note='inspect_ramp')
    print('final status',r.status())
    oo=observe(r,'after_inspection')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    stage=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else 'inspect'
    if stage=='inspect': stage_inspect()
